curation.lead:
Jared Birchall (born 1974, Modesto, California) is the head of Elon Musk's family office, Excession LLC, and the single individual through whom virtually all of Musk's private corporate, charitable, real estate, security, and political payment infrastructure is managed. OpenCorporates records confirm Birchall as officer at 90 or more entities across at least 15 US jurisdictions and the United Kingdom, holding titles including CEO, CFO, president, secretary, treasurer, director, and manager [Finding #6238]. He simultaneously serves as CEO of Neuralink, Executive Officer of xAI Corp, treasurer of the Boring Company, president of The Foundation (the primary recipient of Musk Foundation grants), and director of X.AI London Ltd [Finding #5920] [Finding #6235].

Birchall graduated from Brigham Young University in 1999 and began his career as an analyst at Goldman Sachs. He spent approximately a decade at Merrill Lynch in private wealth management before being dismissed for unauthorized client correspondence. He joined Morgan Stanley in 2010, managing Musk's accounts, and Musk hired him out of Morgan Stanley in 2016 to run the family office [Finding #4399]. Since then, Birchall has functioned as Musk's sole operational proxy in corporate governance, with Musk's name absent from the vast majority of the entities Birchall controls [Finding #5567].

After the 2024 presidential election, Birchall advised the Trump transition team on space policy and AI, while simultaneously holding executive positions at companies with billions of dollars in government contracts and managing the political payment apparatus that channeled over $295 million to America PAC [Finding #4399]. He has zero personal FEC contribution records, consistent with a principal-agent relationship in which he operates as Musk's proxy rather than as an independent political actor [Finding #5613].
curation.system_role: Birchall is the operational chokepoint of the Musk empire: a single individual who controls the family office, holds executive titles at the major operating companies, manages charitable grantmaking, oversees private security and real estate, and administers political spending entities, creating an extraordinary concentration of fiduciary duties and potential conflicts of interest across domains that would normally be segregated.

sections.title: Career Background and Role as Musk's Proxy
sections.content:
Birchall began his finance career as an analyst at Goldman Sachs after graduating from Brigham Young University in 1999. He then spent approximately a decade at Merrill Lynch in private wealth management, where he was eventually dismissed for unauthorized client correspondence. He moved to Morgan Stanley in 2010, where he managed Elon Musk's personal accounts. Musk hired Birchall out of Morgan Stanley in 2016 to establish and run the family office that became Excession LLC [Finding #4399].

The structural design of the Musk entity network is notable: Musk's name appears on almost none of the private entities. Birchall is the named manager, president, or director on virtually all of them. Three core entities -- Excession LLC (SOS #0803683059), Musk Industries LLC (SOS #0803683028), and Foundation Security Inc (SOS #0803683041) -- were all incorporated on the same day, July 14, 2020, at the same PO Box (341886, Austin, TX 78734) with near-sequential Secretary of State file numbers, confirming a coordinated batch filing [Finding #5567] [Finding #5881] [Finding #5878]. This date coincides with Musk's relocation from California to Texas, representing the formalization of the family office structure [Finding #5562].

SEC EDGAR records list Birchall as Executive Officer on 15 Form D filings across four Musk operating companies: Neuralink Corp (CIK 0001708503, six filings, 2017-2025), TBC-The Boring Co (CIK 0001737630, three filings, 2018-2022), X.AI Corp (CIK 0002002695, four filings, 2023-2025), and X.AI Holdings Corp (CIK 0002079267, two filings, 2025-2026) [Finding #6213]. Birchall is not listed as officer or director on any Form D for Red Planet Ventures, despite being confirmed as manager on the Texas formation documents [Finding #6213] [Finding #6236].

sections.title: Corporate Entity Network
sections.content:
OpenCorporates records show Birchall serving as officer at 90 or more entities across Texas, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Mississippi, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Kentucky, Oregon, Washington, and the United Kingdom [Finding #6238]. The entities span Musk's operating companies, the family office, charitable organizations, real estate holdings, private security, educational institutions, and venture vehicles.

The central address of the private entity network is PO Box 341886, Austin, TX 78734 (physical address: 2110 Ranch Road 620 S, Lakeway, TX), which appears on the filings for Excession LLC, Musk Industries LLC, Foundation Security Inc, Musk Foundation, The Foundation, Horse Ranch LLC, Peninsula LLC, and the three Red Planet Ventures entities, among others. All use the same registered agent: Registered Agent Solutions Inc at 5301 Southwest Parkway Suite 400, Austin, TX 78735 [Finding #6229] [Finding #5578].

Key entity categories under Birchall's control include: the family office (Excession LLC, Musk Industries LLC); operating company roles (CEO/CFO/President of Neuralink, Executive Officer of xAI Corp, Treasurer of The Boring Company, Director of X.AI London Ltd); charitable entities (Secretary/Treasurer of Musk Foundation, President of The Foundation); private security (CEO/CFO/President/Secretary/Director of Foundation Security Inc across three company numbers in Texas and California); real estate (Manager/President of Horse Ranch LLC, River Bottoms Ranch LLC, BSP 2023 LLC, Peninsula LLC); infrastructure (Member of CTC Holding LLC, Manager of AIQ Phase LLC, President of CapX Holdco Inc); and investment vehicles (Manager of Red Planet Ventures I, II, and III) [Finding #5920] [Finding #6238] [Finding #5556].

Birchall also held historical positions including CEO/Secretary/CFO of PRAVDA Corp (California, incorporated October 2017, terminated October 2020), Musk's media credibility rating project, at Musk's former personal residence at 216 Park Road, Burlingame, CA [Finding #5573].

sections.title: Charitable Entity Control
sections.content:
Birchall occupies dual gatekeeper positions at Musk Foundation (Secretary/Treasurer) and The Foundation (President), which is the primary recipient of Musk Foundation disbursements [Finding #5920]. In 2024, the Musk Foundation disbursed $474 million in charitable grants, of which $470 million (99.2%) went to The Foundation [Finding #5917]. Birchall's dual role means he effectively controls both the granting entity and the receiving entity.

The Foundation (EIN 92-0742101) is classified as a 501(c)(3) educational institution (NTEE code B20) at PO Box 341886, Austin, TX, with an IRS ruling date of April 2023. Its board has zero independent members: Birchall (President), Ronald Gong (Secretary), Teresa Holland (Treasurer), and Steven Chidester (Trustee). Gong and Holland both work at Catalyst Family Office in California, and Chidester is a tax attorney at Withersworldwide specializing in wealth management [Finding #5903] [Finding #5913]. There are no academic educators, community representatives, or other independent voices on the board despite the entity's stated educational mission.

BSP 2023 LLC, also managed by Birchall, purchased approximately 40 acres in Bastrop County in April 2023 to host Ad Astra, Musk's Montessori-inspired STEM school for children ages 3-9 [Finding #5922]. The entity was specifically created to hold the school property separately from other Musk land holdings in the area.

sections.title: Red Planet Ventures and Infrastructure Entities
sections.content:
Red Planet Ventures I LLC (TX SOS 0805920034), Red Planet Ventures II LLC (TX SOS 0805920052), and Red Planet Ventures III LLC (TX SOS 0805920058) were all formed on February 25, 2025, with Birchall as sole Manager on each Certificate of Formation. All three share the address 2110 Ranch Road 620 S, #341886, Austin, TX 78734 -- the same PO Box as Excession LLC and the rest of the Musk private entity network [Finding #6236] [Finding #6229]. A New York Times investigation identified these entities as part of a network of 15 or more Musk entities sharing this address [Finding #6224]. No public source has identified the fund's purpose, investors, capital, or investments [Finding #6224].

The formation date of February 25, 2025, coincides exactly with an xAI Corp Form D filing (accession 0002002695-25-000001), listing both Musk and Birchall as officers [Finding #6214]. Whether the temporal coincidence reflects coordinated administrative activity or is incidental is unknown. Notably, Birchall does not appear on any SEC Form D for Red Planet Ventures, despite being the named manager on the state formation documents [Finding #6213].

Birchall also manages infrastructure entities supporting xAI's physical operations. He appears in a Solaris Energy Infrastructure (NYSE:SEI) 10-Q filing in connection with CTC Property LLC (a Nevada LLC identified as the entity behind xAI's Memphis Colossus data center) and Stateline Power LLC (a 49.9% joint venture for 900 MW of primary power to the facility) [Finding #6218]. CapX Holdco Inc, formed June 27, 2023, with Birchall as President and Secretary, was established at the family office address during the period of xAI's founding [Finding #5888].

sections.title: Government Contracting and Political Nexus
sections.content:
Birchall is listed as government point of contact and CFO on Neuralink's SAM.gov registration (UEI: JGGFP357J8B8, CAGE: 7VRH1), registered since May 2017. The registration includes PSC codes AJ11, AJ12, AJ13 (R&D medical) and B529 (special studies), indicating active positioning for federal research and development contracts. As of the most recent check, Neuralink had zero federal awards in USASpending -- registered for government contracting but not yet awarded [Finding #5587].

Following the 2024 presidential election, Birchall advised the Trump transition team on space policy and AI [Finding #4399]. This advisory role creates a structural concern: the same person who manages Musk's personal financial empire and holds executive positions at Neuralink, xAI, and the Boring Company was simultaneously advising the incoming administration on policies directly affecting those companies. Musk's companies have received an estimated $38 billion in cumulative government funding, with SpaceX holding $13.5 billion in Department of Defense contracts.

Despite managing a political spending apparatus that channeled over $295 million to America PAC through entities like Europa 100 LLC, Birchall has zero personal FEC contribution records [Finding #5613]. This absence is consistent with operational discipline in maintaining separation between his personal identity and his role as Musk's financial proxy. The political payment infrastructure flows through entities where Birchall is the named manager, but the money is Musk's [Finding #5556].

sections.title: International and UK Operations
sections.content:
Birchall's role extends beyond US jurisdictions. UK Companies House records confirm him as Director of X.AI London Ltd (company number 16131916, incorporated December 12, 2024, registered at 20 Air Street, London W1B 5AN). This appointment gives Birchall legal fiduciary duties under the UK Companies Act while simultaneously managing Musk's US political spending apparatus and serving as officer at 54 or more domestic entities [Finding #5876] [Finding #6235].

The UK directorship represents xAI's entry into the UK regulatory environment. Birchall's date of birth is recorded as September 1974 on the UK filing. His UK Companies House record shows only this one current appointment [Finding #4935]. The 20 Air Street address is in London's Mayfair/Soho area, a common location for corporate offices of international technology companies [Finding #6235].

open_questions: What is the purpose, capitalization, and investor base of Red Planet Ventures I, II, and III? The three-vehicle structure with sequential SOS numbers suggests a fund family, but no SEC filings, investor information, or investment activity has been identified [Finding #6224] [Finding #6236].

What is the relationship between CTC Property LLC (Nevada) and the xAI Memphis Colossus data center, and what is the total power and infrastructure spend that Birchall manages through CTC Holding LLC and Stateline Power LLC? [Finding #6218]

Does Birchall's simultaneous role as Trump transition advisor on space and AI policy and as executive officer at companies receiving billions in federal contracts trigger any formal conflict of interest disclosure requirements, and were any such disclosures filed? [Finding #4399]

What was the nature of Birchall's dismissal from Merrill Lynch for unauthorized client correspondence, and has this regulatory history been disclosed in connection with his current SAM.gov government registration or transition advisory role? [Finding #4399]

What is the governance relationship between Igor Kurganov and Birchall at the Musk Foundation, given that Kurganov reportedly managed $5.7 billion in daily operations before Birchall pushed for his removal in May 2022 after FBI inquiries?
